description: This Java class handles the activation of holiday entities within the system. It implements command processing logic using the Spring framework, specifically by using the @Service annotation, and delegates the activation operation to the HolidayWritePlatformService.

classes.name: ActivateHolidayCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles command processing for activating holidays, marked by entity='HOLIDAY' and action='ACTIVATE'.

methods.name: ActivateHolidayCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the HolidayWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to activate a holiday by calling the dedicated service method.
